name: Mind Admin
description: Full administrative access to all Mind memory collections: read, create, edit, and delete records. Bypasses per-user row-level security policies so the backend service can manage memories on behalf of any user.

name: Mind Editor
description: Create and edit memory records (people, projects, wins, notes, decisions, etc.). Cannot delete records or bypass per-user row-level security.

name: Mind Viewer
description: Read-only access to Mind memory collections. Cannot create, modify, or delete any records.
